description: "The Intellectual Life" by Philip Gilbert Hamerton is a philosophical examination of the endeavors and challenges associated with leading an intellectual life, likely written in the late 19th century. The work navigates the complexities of nurturing one's intellectual faculties amidst various social, physical, and emotional factors.
